components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary control — peach fill, ink text, tactile press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #E98154; color: #161110; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E98154; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Header route with arrow nudge; cognac rest, peach active.
components.html: home
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1px; color: #944929; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -1px; line-height: 28px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-nav-item__icon { display: flex; width: 16px; height: 16px; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #E98154; } .ds-nav-item:hover .ds-nav-item__icon { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E98154; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { color: #E98154; }

components.name: Link Social
components.description: Footer/social row — light Heebo, linen to peach.
components.css: .ds-link-social { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #D8BFA0; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 28px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-link-social__icon { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-link-social:hover { color: #E98154; } .ds-link-social:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-link-social:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E98154; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Reel Card
components.description: Home proof slide — soft rect media, taupe label.
components.css: .ds-card-reel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; width: 318px; } .ds-card-reel__media { aspect-ratio: 1134 / 1383; width: 100%; border-radius: 11px; overflow: hidden; background: #D8BFA0; } .ds-card-reel__title { margin: 0; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; height: 54px; line-height: 54px; color: #9B7F58; }

components.name: Cases Gate Card
components.description: Glass confidentiality card: contact links over blurred proof.
components.html:
Cases omitidos por confidencialidade.

Para ver o material completo, peça acesso. Respondo por e-mail ou LinkedIn.
components.css: .ds-gate-card { width: 100%; max-width: 520px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 28px 28px 24px; border-radius: 11px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #161110 58%, transparent); border: 1px solid rgba(216, 191, 160, 0.2); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(160%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(160%); box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); color: #D8BFA0; } .ds-gate-card__title { margin: 0; font-family: Merriweather, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-gate-card__body { margin: 0; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Identity
components.description: Avatar + wordmark brand column — hero-level signal on every surface.
components.css: .ds-identity { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; width: 222px; color: #D8BFA0; } .ds-identity__avatar { width: 71px; height: 71px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #304D53; } .ds-identity__wordmark { font-family: Merriweather, Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

narrative.overview:
A night briefing room for senior product work: warm copper signal on deep ink, linen type, and cool pine as the quiet counterweight. The atmosphere is professional without formality — confident, direct, and human. Spacing and typography are treated as primary design assets: rhythm, measure, and type pairing carry as much meaning as color.

Depth comes from tonal layering (ink field, scrims, muted labels) rather than a shadow vocabulary. Interaction is tactile and confident — press scales, accent hovers, staggered entrances — always respecting reduced-motion and reduced-transparency preferences.
keyCharacteristics: Warm copper accent on near-black ink; cool pine as secondary structural calm
Generous, intentional spacing scale; type size and tracking as hierarchy
Flat/tonal by default; glass + rare shadow only on the cases gate
Continuous marquee proof on home; locked confidentiality stage on cases

rules.name: The Copper Signal Rule
rules.body: Peach occupies a small fraction of any screen (active state, eyebrow, CTA, focus). If everything glows copper, nothing does.

rules.name: The Ink Field Rule
rules.body: Screens live on ink. Do not introduce large light panels, purple gradients, or cool-gray "AI default" backgrounds.

rules.name: The Type-as-Asset Rule
rules.body: Do not flatten hierarchy into one size/weight. Spacing between identity column and intro (~76px) and the 7px eyebrow→headline gap are part of the brand, not leftovers.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Intro copy stays within ~645px. Do not stretch headlines full-bleed edge-to-edge.

rules.name: The Scrim-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Prefer ink scrims and blur to separate private proof from the UI. Do not invent card stacks with multi-layer drop shadows on home or career.

rules.name: The Soft Rect Rule
rules.body: Default interactive and media surfaces use ~11px radius. Do not go fully squared or pill-shaped on cards/buttons (avatar excepted).

dos: Do keep Peach rare and purposeful (active, eyebrow, CTA, focus).
Do treat Merriweather + Heebo roles as fixed: serif for voice, sans for chrome.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion (fade-only enters; marquee → scroll) and prefers-reduced-transparency (solid gate, no blur).
Do lead each surface with Identity + eyebrow + headline before secondary proof.
Do keep cases locked visually: blur + scrim + gate; contact is the unlock path.
donts: Don't migrate the whole system to utility-class sprawl or invent a second palette.
Don't add purple/cyan AI-slop gradients, glow stacks, or light dashboard cards on ink.
Don't unlock or fabricate case content in UI.
Don't center everything into a marketing card grid; the briefing room is asymmetric (identity column + measure-limited intro).
Don't pause the home marquee for decorative controls unless product requirements change.
